# Sub-processors

> **Draft — lawyer approval required.**

A new sub-processor is announced on this page and by e-mail to administrators at least 30 days before it starts; an administrator can object, and if we cannot meet the objection the company can end the affected service with a refund. Transfers outside the customer’s country use the safeguards in the Data processing agreement (EU standard contractual clauses, the UK addendum, the KVKK standard contract, and the rider for the customer’s country).

| Company | What for | Where the data is | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cloudflare, Inc. | Hosting of the application, the network in front of it, file storage (R2), incoming mail routing. | United States and [R2 location] | Always |
| Supabase, Inc. | The database (PostgreSQL) holding accounts, company data and backups. | [EU region] | Always |
| Google LLC / Google Ireland Ltd (Google Workspace) | Our own company mailboxes, and sending the product’s e-mails (sign-in links, reminders, summaries) through the Workspace SMTP relay. | Ireland and United States | Always |
| Paddle.com Market Ltd | Payments, invoices and sales tax as merchant of record (only the paying company’s billing contact). | United Kingdom and United States | Paid plans |
| Anthropic PBC | Answers of the built-in AI assistant (CuraAI, help, support). Only the minimum needed is sent; it is never used to train models. | United States | Only when the company turns AI features on |
| Resend, Inc. | A dedicated e-mail sending service — not used today; only if the product’s mail volume outgrows the Workspace relay (announced 30 days ahead). | United States | Not used today |
| Google LLC | "Sign in with Google" and Google Sheets — only when the company turns them on. | United States | Only when the company turns it on |
| Microsoft Corporation | "Sign in with Microsoft" and Excel — only when the company turns them on. | United States | Only when the company turns it on |

**Not our sub-processors:** the tools a company connects itself (its CRM, chat app, support tool, accounting system). Data moves to them on the company’s instruction, under its own agreement with them.

**AI:** customer data and questions are never used to train models, by us or by the model provider; the provider is bound to this in writing.

**Support session recording** adds no sub-processor and is off by default: when a company turns it on, the recordings stay in our own database for 7 days.
